title: Post-deploy authed production smoke runs again with a renewed QA session
acceptance: The owner renews the QA beta account session and stores it only in the ignored apps/api/.qa-beta-token (never committed or printed), per deployment-runbook.md › Authed production smoke.
pnpm --filter @ritmofit/api exec tsx scripts/authed-production-smoke.ts exits 0 against production, and the next deploy entry in HISTORY records that it ran.
The runbook says what to do when the token has expired (who renews it, and that the deploy entry names the skip), so an expired token is not silently skipped deploy after deploy.

evidence.summary: Deploy entries for 2026-10-28, 2026-10-29 and 2026-10-30 each record the authed smoke as skipped or failing with 401 because the QA token expired.
Authed production smoke section: the token lives only in apps/api/.qa-beta-token and the script must return 200 for its checks.

Both 2026-10-31 deploy entries record the authed smoke as not passing because the QA session is expired: 401 on 97f4454 (Worker ffcf858d), skipped on 0a77110 (Worker 61cdeb33). It has not passed since 2026-10-26.

The 2026-11-21 deploys were the first from the Neo. apps/api/.qa-beta-token is not on the Neo (the Air held it), so the authed smoke did not run on any of the four. A renewed QA session token has to be placed on the Neo.

Owner, Neo session, 2026-11-23: "my own account is the smoke account". The owner signed in on ritmofit.studio, signed out once to end a session whose value had appeared in a screenshot, and saved a fresh session token to the gitignored apps/api/.qa-beta-token on the Neo (one line, 79 bytes, mode 600). No agent read the value.
Against https://ritmofit.studio at 2026-11-23T17:58Z (main b9e8141, Worker fedc7fbf): GET /api/v1/classes 200, GET /api/v1/providers/spotify/playlists 200, exit 0.

Authed production smoke: the smoke account is the owner's own account; only the owner renews the token (with the pbpaste command); an exposed value means sign out and save a fresh one; a deploy with a missing or expired token names the skip in its HISTORY entry.
The 2026-11-23 "Authed production smoke" entry, recorded with the b9e8141 deploy, says the smoke ran and passed.
This task's PR: the smoke result in HISTORY, the runbook's renewal steps, and RF-155 Done.

resolution: The owner renewed the smoke session on 2026-11-23 from their own account, which is the smoke account, and saved it only in the gitignored apps/api/.qa-beta-token on the Neo. The authed production smoke then passed against main b9e8141 (Worker fedc7fbf): classes 200 and Spotify playlists 200, the first pass since 2026-10-26, recorded in HISTORY in its own entry right after that deploy's entry. The runbook now says whose session it is, that only the owner renews it and how, and that a deploy with a missing or expired token names the skip in HISTORY.
